name: OMP Usage & Cost
author: iamanro
description: Subscription usage for every oh-my-pi (omp) provider and account, with reset times and API-equivalent cost.

barWidget.description: Pool usage per provider in the bar; the panel lists every account with its limits, resets, reset credits and API-equivalent cost from the OMP session logs, plus spend on pay-as-you-go providers.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Seconds between snapshots. Opening the panel always refreshes.

schema.label: omp command
schema.description: Name on PATH or absolute path of the omp executable.

schema.label: Alert at (%)
schema.description: Pool usage at which a provider turns the urgent colour.

schema.label: Show today's cost in the bar
schema.description: Append today's API-equivalent cost after the percentages.

schema.label: Hide e-mails
schema.description: Mask account e-mails (a•••@e•••.com) and organisation names, e.g. for screen sharing.

schema.label: Demo data
schema.description: Show invented accounts and spend instead of your own, for screenshots.

schema.label: Language
schema.description: auto follows LANGUAGE / LC_ALL / LC_MESSAGES / LANG of the shell; unsupported languages fall back to English.
